part.text:
Fixed. The `FCALL`/`FCALL_RO` commands carry `CMD_SKIP_MONITOR` (src/commands.c:7271), so the outer fcall was never shown in MONITOR — only the inner `redis.call` executed as the `lua` client appeared.

The fix in `fcallCommandGeneric` (src/functions.c:618) explicitly feeds the monitor with the fcall command before running the function, mirroring how `evalCommand`/`evalShaCommand` already do it (src/eval.c:554,568). This makes MONITOR output show `fcall <function>` followed by the commands the function executes.

Verified: `unit/introspection` (includes "MONITOR can log commands issued by functions") and `unit/functions` both pass.
